title: The W3 Total Cache plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized File Deletion in all versions up to, and…
description: The W3 Total Cache WordPress plugin up to and including version 2.11.0 contains a vulnerability that allows authenticated users with Author-level or higher privileges to delete any media library attachment, including files owned by other users. This occurs due to improper authorization checks in the ajax_revert() AJAX handler, which uses attacker-controlled post meta values to delete attachments without verifying ownership or delete permissions. The nonce intended to protect this action is exposed to users with upload_files capability, making exploitation feasible.
